purpose: Prevent dense proposal clusters around a strong TRAIN person from dominating a weaker person in the same snapshot
weights: Within each snapshot, equal positive mass per represented true person, then equal per positive proposal for that person; negative proposals share remaining mass; original normalized physical-world budgets preserved
ground_truth_used_only_for: TRAIN labels and sample weights, never inference features
global_validation_selection: Same threshold/NMS/height across all areas, plus .95/.97/.99/.995 thresholds to accommodate changed TRAIN class mass
source_reason: Development actual-rollout oracle covers18/18 people but selected outputs detect16/18; focus the loss on source-balanced classification rather than claiming oracle recall as achieved
